authoring_constraints: No scene, organization name, person, date, number, question or answer before parent commits this protocol and new helper freeze.
Clearly mark each future raw document as AI-authored synthetic evaluation data about a fictional organization.
Use one newly invented organization; do not reuse previous pool wording, events, facts or numeric answers.
No real personal data, private uploads or facts copied from the validation family.
Write natural Korean paragraphs and lists; use tables only where natural. Do not adjust source line or paragraph length to candidate segmentation.
Distribute policy and decision/execution evidence across documents without duplicating every sufficient fact in each source.
Distinguish proposals, decisions, unresolved matters, assigned actions and completed actions explicitly.
If rules or decisions change or are cancelled, state target and ordering; assignment does not imply completion.
Author raw UTF-8/LF/NFC text and verify service normalization identity.
Review source coherence and freeze complete source bodies/hashes before writing calibration questions and oracles.

processing_protocol.scope: Full adopted documents before context selection; no policy adapter or frozen source41 edits.
processing_protocol.raw_policy: Retain exact upstream bytes, LF, final newline, BOM/CR observations and SHA256 in ignored raw snapshots.
processing_protocol.decode: Strict UTF-8; follow existing service ingest removal of a leading UTF-8 BOM.
processing_protocol.normalization: Existing service ingest only: CRLF/CR to LF then Unicode NFC. Both adopted public sources verified identity.
prohibited_transformations: paragraph splitting or merging to fit C2
processing_protocol.pages: One page (0, full processed codepoint length, null) per Markdown or synthetic text source.

pseudocode: if end < page.end: find greatest index in [start + 500, end) whose character is LF or ASCII SPACE; if present set end = index + 1
register source[start:end] unchanged when nonblank with ordinal equal to prior registered chunk count
if end == page.end stop, else start = max(start + 1, end - 150)
chunk_algorithm.parameter_origin: Existing Java/Python service code, not C2 block-cap tuning.

processing_protocol.coordinate_system: Unicode codepoints in full processed document; zero-based half-open [start,end).
processing_protocol.revision_semantics: Evaluation snapshot revision1, not upstream Git commit count.

context_selection_protocol.selection_time: After protocol/helper freeze and source-body inventory freeze, before tokenizer preparation and either arm output.
context_selection_protocol.allowed_units: Whole unmodified service chunks from full-document inventory; never sentence/paragraph resegmentation.
context_selection_protocol.semantic_rule: Choose source scope on task relevance; include service chunks needed for actor, condition, temporal and status qualifications. Record scope and semantic reason independent of either adapter.
context_selection_protocol.order: source registration_ordinal ascending, then chunk ordinal ascending
forbid: merging adjacent chunks into one context
injecting headings or attribution into evidence text
selecting/reselecting by C2 block size or line/block ID count
selecting/reselecting after official token preparation or model output
omitting source-available essential evidence to manufacture abstention
replacing preparation failures or lowering registered counts
context_selection_protocol.failure_rule: If either arm fails source/grammar/context/token preparation, preserve preparation failure; do not trim, rewrite, swap contexts or silently replace a case.
context_selection_protocol.multi_source_rule: Every sufficient allowed evidence combination must require two distinct (document_id, revision) pairs; two chunks of one document do not qualify.
context_selection_protocol.source_syntax_rule: Retain complete raw/processed corpus including its table; preserve naturally mixed prose/list/structural syntax without adapter-driven selection.
